title: UneceLogisticsStatus
description: The information relevant to a condition or a position related to logistics.

arrivalReportedEvent.description: A transport arrival event reported for this logistics status.

contactParty.description: A contact party for this logistics status.

departureReportedEvent.description: A transport departure event reported for this logistics status.

description.description: The textual description of this logistics status.

information.description: Information, expressed as text, for this logistics status.

loadingReportedEvent.description: A transport loading event reported for this logistics status.

logisticsStatusConditionCode.description: The code specifying this logistics status condition [UNECE Recommendation 24].

logisticsStatusReasonCode.description: A code specifying a reason for this logistics status [UNECE Recommendation 24].

reason.description: A reason, expressed as text, for this logistics status.

referenceDateTime.description: The reference date, time, date time or other date time value for this logistics status.

reportedSupplyChainEvent.description: A supply chain event reported for this logistics status.

sequenceNumeric.description: The sequence number of this logistics status, such as within a status report.

specifiedLogisticsLocation.description: A location specified for this logistics status.

unloadingReportedEvent.description: A transport unloading event reported for this logistics status.

validityPeriod.description: A specific validity period for this logistics status.
